payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute binomial coefficients with 2D DP (Pascal's triangle), then iterate over bits of n+2 to count valid m by selecting bit positions.
payload.rationale: Solution builds a 2D DP table f[i][j] to compute C(i,j), then uses bit-level combinatorial counting. This is a digit DP variant leveraging 2D DP precomputation.
